name: SIR STICKS
tagline: Has one sword and a lot of confidence about it.
description: A black-line stick figure on off-white paper. Head: an empty circle, no face. Sitting on top of the head is a small, wide, low red triangle drawn as a hollow outline, the only colour on the page, like a tiny conical hat. One straight vertical line for the body. Both arms start at the same point a third of the way down the body: the figure's right arm (viewer's left) hangs down and out diagonally, empty; the other arm rises up and out to the viewer's right, gripping a sword. The sword has a short crossguard line drawn at a right angle across the hilt and a single straight blade, drawn noticeably thicker than every other line, pointing up and to the right, about half as long as the whole figure. Two straight legs in an upside-down V. No hands, no feet.
card: SPECIAL  Throw sword, go pick it up
